==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV Starleague Season 9''' (아프리카TV 스타리그 시즌9) or '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 9''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].<ref>[https://namu.wiki/w/%EC%95%84%ED%94%84%EB%A6%AC%EC%B9%B4TV%20%EC%8A%A4%ED%83%80%EB%A6%AC%EA%B7%B8%20%EC%8B%9C%EC%A6%8C9 Afreeca Starleague Season 8]</ref>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nwNASWGzFVA</embedvideo>

==Tournament Information==
===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: {{abbr/Bo1}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[AfreecaTV Starleague Season 8]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: First two matches: {{abbr/Bo1}} - Final three matches: {{abbr/Bo3}} 
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** Quarterfinals & Semi-Finals: {{abbr/Bo5}}
** Finals: {{abbr/Bo7}}
